notes.title: Version 0.9.0 Release
notes.content:
Version 0.9.0 has been released to closed alpha testers.


Added new ship assets for all Gaian ships.
Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck in the training mission and be unable to proceed by examining an enemy ship near the start of the mission.
Fixed an issue where the ship card The Archleon King would have zero ship statistics, such as speed and power.
Fixed a major layout issue with the stockpile (resource totals) shown on the user interface.
Fixed a few minor issues with text positioning on card layouts.


As always, we encourage you to send feedback about your experience, either through the in-game form or using the contact page on our website. 

Good luck, commanders!

notes.title: Version 0.8.0 Release
notes.content:
Version 0.8.0 has been released to closed alpha testers. We've made some major visual improvements. For more information, check out the patch preview.

New Features

Added new assets for stars and planets.
Added new ship assets for the Archleon Empire. 
Pressing F11 will now toggle display of the in-game user interface. 
Changed the lighting model from gamma to linear for more realistic rendering. Some parts of the interface may have changed color as a result.
Added a higher-resolution background. 

Improvements and Fixes

Upgraded the engine from Unity 2017 to Unity 2019. Expect some performance and stability improvements. 
Updated the text on some of the in-game menus.
Fixed an issue where it was possible to select an empty hex after destroying the ship on it during the training mission.

notes.title: Version 0.7.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
Version 0.7.0 of the game has been released to closed alpha testers.


Added the training campaign, accessible from the main menu.
The tutorial, introduced in 0.5.0, has been removed.


For more information, make sure to check out the patch preview posted on the website.

Good luck, commanders.

notes.title: 0.6.0 Release Notes
notes.content: Version 0.6.0 of the game has been released to closed alpha testers. This new release will automatically start the tutorial for brand-new players. We highly recommend you try the in-game tutorial if you haven't already.

notes.title: 0.5.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
Version 0.5.0 has been released to closed alpha testers.


 A training button has been added to the main menu. We highly recommend all aspiring commanders to press this button and go through basic training to learn the fundamentals of interstellar warfare.
 A feedback button has been added to the main menu as well. We strongly encourage that you press this button and fill out the feedback form so we can make the game better. This form can also be used to report bugs.

notes.title: 0.4.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
Version 0.4.0 of the game has been released to closed alpha testers.


 Redesigned the main menu.
 Added sounds for Nexian ships.
 Removed some unnecessary buttons around issuing orders to units.


Make sure to check back often for the latest updates!

notes.title: 0.3.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
Version 0.3.0 of the game has been released to closed alpha testers.


 Added some additional checks to ensure that multiplayer matches stay in sync.
 Fixed a variety of major bugs with multiplayer.


Going forward, we are planning to release patches about every 6 weeks. Make sure to check back often for the latest updates!

notes.title: 0.2.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
This is our first patch.


Added background music when playing a match against the computer or other players.
Fixed a major issue where capital worlds would appear on the game board when starting a multiplayer match.
Made some minor tweaks and fixes to the main menu.


We encourage you to send us feedback directly using this form, and report any bugs by sending an email to support@galactic-games.net.

notes.title: 0.1.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
This is the initial closed alpha launch of the game.

Major Features

You can start a match against a computer player with by pressing "Play Now" on the main menu, or by pressing "Setup Game" on the main menu.
You can view existing multiplayer matches and start your own multiplayer match by pressing "Multiplayer" on the main menu.
You can place ships and planets on the game board.
You can attack with those ships to destroy enemy ships and conquer planets.
You can win the game by conquering the enemy player's capital world. (Of course, this means you can lose the game if your capital world is conquered.)


Known Issues

There are some desynchronization issues that can occur in multiplayer.
Card effects have not been implemented yet, although you can see information about card effects by examining cards.
In the setup game menu, certain deck names are cut off in the user interface.
The text "closed alpha" in the lower right corner of the menus is sometimes cut off.
You can attempt to place cards "through" the hand UI by dragging and dropping a card out of your hand and then back into your hand.
